DynaTPH.available_local: descriptor.csv and peptide-only mean RMSF table (3 replicas), no individual-repeat arrays or chi entropy
DynaTPH.units_caution: rmsf.csv header declares nm but values around0.3–0.8; verify fit protocol and units against authors before comparing absolute predictions.
DynaTPH.old_README_access: Full trajectories restricted for peer review at Zenodo21971877. Re-check if needed; not presumed currently inaccessible.

3KXF.old_exclusion_reason: Exact PDB overlap with DynaRepo A005I in previous general training pool, not a trajectory integrity exclusion.
3KXF.use: Can evaluate with same family-fold0 checkpoint; must independently generate ITrace targets and preserve source-specific chain mapping. Repeated structure/second MD protocol does not add independent PDB.

knapp2019.other_sources: 1G4, JM22 and LC13 public Figshare URLs and exact archive sizes in local literature/knapp2019_*_figshare.json; not present as complete local trajectories.
knapp2019.A6_construct_caution: Three internal beta-chain regions removed in prepared simulation construct; do not treat as intact natural A6.
